title: node.rs forwarder DAO anti-spoof gate uses link-local same_interface — dead for routable parent forms; needs own-routable-identity input
description: Sibling of ssg9 (router.rs root-side gate, fixed). rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs ~:610: the 'we are a DAO parent' check compares advertised DAO parents via same_interface(parent, self.node.node_id.link_local_addr()) — low-half equality against the link-local IID. Post-i72x.2 production DAO writers name the parent in ROUTABLE form (node.rs:1443 parent_addr = ygg_addr_from_pubkey(parent.pubkey)), so this gate is dead for the routable parent form just as ssg9's was. Fixing it needs the forwarder's OWN routable /128, which is NOT reachable at that call site (RplNode holds only node_id EUI-64 + Router; Router has no node_addr field; DaoManager stores node_address but exposes no getter). That is the same design input nnmc (parent two-forms) must settle — do NOT hack it in isolation. Coordinate with nnmc.
